notes: Independent check 2026-11-16: only Royal Veterinary Center confirmed on its own page. Removed 8 entries that rested only on aggregator/magazine pages (mlocal.biz directory, Macau Lifestyle magazine) with no confirmation on the clinics own or an official page: Green Cross Taipa, Green Cross Sidonio Pais (own site greencrossvetclinic.com refused by WebFetch; magazine claims 24 h for Taipa but lists Mon-Sat hours), A+ Dream Animal Hospital (directory says 24 hours), Charming Pet Hospital, Our Pets Vet Clinic, Life Animal Clinic, An Kin Animal Medical Centre, Macau Animal Hospital Company Ltd. Follow-up candidates once own/official pages are reachable: those clinics plus the official IAM list of licensed clinics (https://www.iam.gov.mo/canil/e, refused by WebFetch). IAM reported 25 provisional clinic licences, so many licensed clinics are missing. No duty rota or animal poison line found. Government Macao Municipal Kennel is a municipal service, not an entry.
